content.text: The rule seems to be removing the snake-like line while keeping dots outside it in place, but dots inside get erased. I notice there's no actual test input provided to apply this rule to, which is odd since I'd expect one to be given at this point.

I need to remove all the 2s and also remove any 3s that fall inside the closed loop the snake forms, so I'm tracing through each row to map out exactly where the 2s are located before figuring out the loop's interior.

Checking specific cells like r6c9 and r10c6 against the loop's boundaries confirms they sit inside the enclosed region, so those 3s get removed too, while cells like r1c1, r5c14, and r12c2 are clearly outside and stay untouched.
